properties.site-address: Goose Hill Police Station, Castle Bank, Morpeth
properties.notes: Former police station that has been sold for redevelopment following relocation to a new site within Morpeth. A scheme is likely to involve conversion of the existing buildings alongside an element of new-build development. An application is currently pending for proposed development of the site for 32 units (17/02588/FUL)., This is proposed to be through refurbishment and change of use (6 houses) and the demolition of other buildings for new-build construction (7 houses and 19 apartments). There could be opportunity to link and complement recent and proposed residential development on adjacent land.
